notes.title: Game Update: The Subway Station Is Now Open!
notes.content: [p]Sprint through dimly lit tunnels and across roaring train tracks in a heart-pounding race for survival! Every leap could be your last—keep your momentum, dodge danger, and own the rails in this underground parkour escape![/p]

notes.title: Update: Four New Playable Characters!
notes.content: Four new playable characters have joined the race!

notes.title: VIP UPDATE!
notes.content:
Introducing the VIP System for Enhanced Performance in Competitions (Excludes "Race with the Soldier" Event)
- Earn 5 VIP points for each competition.
- Reach 15 VIP points to attain VIP 1.
- Reach 30 VIP points for VIP 2.
- Reach 45 VIP points for VIP 3.
- Reach 80 VIP points for VIP 4.
- Reach 130 VIP points for VIP 5.
- Reach 200 VIP points for VIP 6.
- Reach 400 VIP points for VIP 7.
- Reach 640 VIP points for VIP 8.
Higher VIP levels grant more bonus cash from competitions. Additionally, VIP levels above 6 unlock exclusive extra discounts.

notes.title: Game Update – Shop & Sprint: Extended Tracks, Fierce Rivals, & New Gear!
notes.content:
- The running track in the city has been extended, featuring two new fast opponents.
- New items, including neon light numbers and shapes, have been added to the merchant store.
- Jumping now increases players' hunger and thirst.

notes.title: Running Track Update for the 'Race with the Soldier' Event
notes.content:
- The running track or race track for the "Race with the Soldier" event has been redesigned and decorated with neon lights and other features.  
- The "Race with the Soldier" event has been extended, and the soldier will no longer disappear after completing the race.

notes.title: Bug Fixes: Patch v1.1.5.6.45.01
notes.content: The issue with backpack storage has been solved, and items stored in the backpack can now be saved without any issues!

notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch v1.0.9.5.34.97
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where items in the inventory would disappear when a player removed their backpack.
- Players can now climb over fences and rooftops in the Northern Asian village or town.
- Items stored in chests no longer vanish when traveling between maps.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch v1.0.9.0.95.88
notes.content: Fixed the player's health bar update after being healed by the doctor.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch v1.0.9.9.83.79
notes.content: Fixed the day-and-night cycle for the game

notes.title: Maps Update
notes.content:
- I added music to the maps that previously did not have it.  
- Bears have been added to the original map, but don't get too close to them.  
- The village or city in the north has been redesigned to allow players to sneak into it more easily after evading the dangerous creatures. However, danger still lurks in the corners.  
- There is a way to obtain the treasure, but players will need to figure it out on their own.  
- I fixed some bugs.  
- The game save option has been restored.

notes.title: Bugs Fix Event Notifications Added Player Stats Adjustments Patch v1.0.9.8.67.59
notes.content: Bug fixes and notifications added regarding sports stadium opening and closing times, as well as other sports event notifications. Minor player stats adjustments. Pumpkins have been placed inside the chest.

notes.title: Run-Sprint-Parkour! is Now Live!
notes.content: All upcoming game updates will be completely free of charge!
